scenario.description: A division director must reset the operating rules for a cross-functional product review forum after several tense meetings, deciding who will facilitate it, how concerns can be raised, and what preparation standards will apply.

shared_context.S1: The cross-functional product review forum meets every Thursday to resolve launch issues involving product, design, sales, and operations.
shared_context.S2: Maya has authority to set the forum's facilitator, participation rules, and preparation standards.
shared_context.S3: The forum currently has no standing facilitator, no consistent way to submit concerns before meetings, and no required agenda lead time.
shared_context.S4: At the next operating review, Maya follows the team's normal practice of asking the people who participate in the forum and HR to recommend concrete changes before she finalizes the new arrangement.

PF1.text: Before leaving the division, the former product director informally committed Jordan to serve as the forum's facilitator for the next 6 weeks, and Jordan already accepted that assignment; the former director left before recording it in the operating plan.

PF2.text: During the last three forum meetings, Leila observed two participants withholding concerns until private follow-up conversations because they feared being challenged in front of the group; a confidential question channel and two private check-ins per month would address the pattern, but she has not yet documented that observation for Maya.

PF3.text: Andre checked with HR this week and confirmed that the forum's new rules must require agendas at least 48 hours before each meeting and facilitator training before anyone leads a session; this policy confirmation has not yet been added to Maya's operating-review materials.

acceptance_conditions: Jordan must facilitate the forum for exactly 6 weeks.
The forum must provide a confidential question channel.
The forum must include exactly 2 private check-ins per month.
Agendas must be distributed at least 48 hours before each meeting.
Facilitator training must be required before anyone leads a session.
The settlement must formally establish Jordan's temporary 6-week facilitation assignment.
A commitment to maintain the confidential question channel and private check-ins must be logged.

content_checks.C7: 'PF1' in credited_facts and decisions['forum_facilitator'] == 'Jordan' and decisions['facilitator_term_weeks'] == 6
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] in ['process', 'confidential_question_channel', 'private_checkins', 'documentation', 'process-design', 'process_implementation', 'implementation_detail'] or 'confidential question channel' in c['detail'] or 'private check-in' in c['detail'] or 'private checkins' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The former director's accepted commitment changes the facilitator choice to Jordan and fixes the assignment term at exactly 6 weeks, while formalizing that choice in the settlement establishes the previously undocumented assignment.
Leila's observation of withheld concerns changes the participation design to a confidential question channel and exactly 2 private check-ins per month, requiring a corresponding support commitment.
HR's confirmed rule changes the preparation standard to exactly 48 hours of agenda notice and makes facilitator training mandatory.
